thread:
ryan (Eng Manager): Heads up — taylor (contractor) flagged that the national day fell on a weekend so they couldn't take the observed holiday. They're asking if we can convert one accrued sick hour to a floating half-day so they can observe on Mon 11/6.

taylor (Contractor): yep. i'm part-time (60% FTE) and my contract says no floating holidays. i did have 8 hrs of sick leftover (pro-rated). any way to swap 4 of those for a half-day observance?

emily (People Ops): thanks for flagging. contractors generally don't get floating days unless in contract. however we sometimes grant one-off observance swaps for legally recognized days when they fall on non-working days. need manager approval + payroll confirmation.

sophia (Payroll): payroll note: for contractors we can do a manual PTO-type adjustment if approved, but must be recorded before the month-end invoice cutoff (11/15) to appear on the current invoice. otherwise it'll show on the next invoice. also we need a short reason string for auditing.

emily (People Ops): process: 1) manager approves in thread (ryan pls). 2) emily will file an "Off-cycle Time Adjustment" ticket with hr_tools_bot including contractor ID + reason. 3) payroll will apply manual entry. example reason: "Observed National Day swap for weekend occurrence - 4h"

ryan (Eng Manager): i approve. makes sense to me. taylor has good attendance and this is local observance. :+1:

hr_tools_bot: please submit Off-cycle Time Adjustment form at https://hr.internal/forms/time-adjustment. Required fields: employee_id, date_of_adjustment, hours, reason, manager_approval_screenshot.

taylor (Contractor): filing now, attaching the note from my vendor agreement that says no floating days but allows exceptions per local law.

emily (People Ops): quick policy clarifier for the record: - Full-time employees: floating holidays expire year-end unless carryover approved. - Part-time & contractors: no automatic floating days; exceptions considered case-by-case for statutory/local observances. Exceptions must be requested by manager by invoice/payroll cutoff.

sophia (Payroll): once we get the form + manager approval screenshot i'll tag finance and push the manual adjustment. Expect it to show on the 11/30 invoice if submitted by 11/15.

emily (People Ops): noted. i'll open the HR ticket once taylor confirms form submitted and paste the ticket ID here.

taylor (Contractor): submitted 11/06 form, attached manager approval screenshot.

emily (People Ops): ticket created: ID #HR-2026-489. forwarding to payroll.

sophia (Payroll): recorded and queued for manual adjustment. will update when done.

emily (People Ops): thanks all. marking resolved once payroll confirms. small ask: if you see multiple contractors requesting the same, escalate to people-ops for a bundle exception so we can standardize the handling. :sparkles:
